VBO:0201224.summary: Energetic and affectionate in her keeper’s account, Peggy was a Shih-Poo at one year and nine months old. Her mother was a Shih Tzu and her father a Toy Poodle. Three-year-old Maggie’s owner described an intelligent dog who could be shy with unfamiliar people and noticed visitors entering the home. Regular grooming was part of Maggie’s routine.
VBO:0201224.shortDescription: Shih-Poo owners describe Peggy’s energy and affection, and Maggie’s shyness with unfamiliar people and alertness to visitors.
